scope: Reviewed observations in Books 4–6. Each event first appears at its supporting paragraph.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold Venison Box
events.summary: Carl receives a Gold Venison Box for entering the stairwell in the top ten. Current and future bounties on him double.
